title: Atomic Transactions with MULTI/EXEC & Optimistic Locking
summary: Learn how Redis queues commands with MULTI, guarantees all-or-nothing sequential execution with EXEC, and uses WATCH for optimistic lock validation.

steps.title: Initialize banking balances
steps.explanation: Set up two bank accounts for an atomic money transfer: Alice starts with $100 and Bob with $50.

steps.title: Execute an atomic transfer inside MULTI/EXEC
steps.explanation: When you call MULTI, Redis flags the client connection as DIRTY_CAS / TRANSACTION. Subsequent commands are queued in memory and respond with +QUEUED until EXEC executes them consecutively.
steps.command:
MULTI
DECRBY play:bank:alice 40
INCRBY play:bank:bob 40
EXEC
steps.hint: Execute the pipeline: MULTI, then DECRBY play:bank:alice 40, INCRBY play:bank:bob 40, and EXEC.

steps.title: Optimistic concurrency control with WATCH
steps.explanation: WATCH monitors keys for modifications before a transaction begins. If another client modifies a watched key before EXEC, Redis marks the transaction dirty and EXEC returns a nil array (aborted).
steps.command:
WATCH play:bank:alice
MULTI
INCRBY play:bank:alice 10
EXEC
steps.hint: Run WATCH play:bank:alice, then MULTI, INCRBY play:bank:alice 10, EXEC.
